jobs.title: Telecom security trainer
jobs.description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces. Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub). Job Description Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide. Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies. This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning. Responsibilities Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives. Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team. jobs.title: Mentor, Claude Corps
jobs.description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI. We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work. We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it. About the Role Location: Remote, United States Role-Type: Full-Time, W2 Employee Reports To: AI Practice Lead, Claude Corps Compensation: $110,000 to $124,500 per year Start Date: No later than February 8th, ahead of the March 8th cohort launch Together with Anthropic, CodePath launched Claude Corps in June 2026, a national fellowship program with a $150 million commitment to place 1,000 AI-trained fellows at nonprofits across America. As a CodePath Mentor, you are the full-time coach and guide for a portfolio of roughly ten pods: about 20 fellows across 8–12 host organizations, from pre-Basecamp through the final day of the program. Your job is to help each fellow succeed not only in building with AI, but in navigating the organization around the work: understanding the problem, identifying the right stakeholders, communicating ideas clearly, building buy-in, and turning an AI-enabled solution into something people will actually use. The host organization directs the fellow's day-to-day work, the curriculum team owns what they learn, and your Sr. Manager of AI Practice is the manager of record who holds the performance bar. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
